Mille Lacs Lake: Minnesota Smallmouth Fishing

Make smallmouth the focus of a day on Mille Lacs. Enjoy time on this Minnesota lake with a bass rod and another cast ahead.

About this water

The fishery source record for Mille Lacs Lake, United States, identifies Walleye, Smallmouth bass, Northern pike and Muskellunge.

This Mille Lacs plan asks about smallmouth bass rather than copying a walleye itinerary. Ask the guide to specify the intended presentation, area and supplied equipment for that objective. Keep muskellunge or pike as separately agreed alternatives, not extra expectations created by the species list. Confirm the departure and actual fishing duration. A lake-wide fish record cannot determine which setup or program best fits your party's day.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Minnesota

Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Visiting children under 16 must use a parent's or guardian's licence or obtain a youth licence.

  • 24 hours$14 USD
  • 72 hours$36 USD
  • 7 consecutive days$43 USD
  • Through February 28, 2027$51 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Smallmouth bass harvest runs May 23–September 13 in 2026; release all smallmouth outside that period.
  • Check the current lake notice for bag limits and any changes before fishing.
  • Use the named-water entry for Mille Lacs Lake; check seasonal, tackle and catch limits official regulations ↗
